Name: Handy Headphones
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
Handy Headphones is a mod that let's you play any in-game music by wearing either the [b]headphones [/b]or [b]earbuds[/b] hats. The earbuds is a less obtrusive version of the headphones.

To purchase either hat, visit the [url=https://stardewcommunitywiki.com/Abandoned_House]hat shop[/url].

To use the [b]headphones [/b]or [b]earbuds[/b], simply equip them and a prompt will appear to select a soundtrack. If you unequip the item, the normal music will play.

To change the music track you selected, you can [b]right click[/b] the headphones or earbuds while wearing them to bring up the prompt again.

Additionally, the headphones / earbuds will let any event music play and resume your selected track when the event ends.

There is a third hat, called [b]studio headphones[/b], that allows you to play all the in-game sounds with the background music muted. This may be useful for modders!

[b]Install[/b]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install this mod.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.


[b]Configurations[/b]
After running the game once with the mod installed, you will see a [b]config.json[/b] under the [b]...\HandyHeadphones\[/b][b]HandyHeadphones[/b] folder.

It contains the following option(s):
[list]
[*][b]ShowAllMusicTracks [/b]| If set to True, it will allow you to play all music tracks, regardless if you've unlocked them | Default: False
[/list]
